I think I let Jane Eyre raise my hopes for this. It was old, and a romance, and boring. I do like the social critique and commentary aspect but it definitely would have held more weight if I still lived in a world like the one depicted. Not bad writing just nothing for me to enjoy. Good stuff to know for Jeopardy though.
